Context: 6. Permanent transfer to and from Central Autonomous/Statutory Bodies Counting of past service for pension

From a Central Autonomous Body to a Central Government  
Department.-The above procedure will apply.  
Autonomous Body will discharge its pension liability by paying in lumpsum the pension/service gratuity/terminal gratuity and retirement gratuity for the service up to the date of absorption. Lumpsum amount of pension will be determined with reference to Commutation  
The Government/ Table laid down in CCS (Commutation of Pension) Rules.
